comparison.objective: Remove magnetic and battery-powered objects from an MRI cart while leaving safe look-alikes; the candidate adjusts gripper hardware.
comparison.physical_skill: Semantic classification and varied multi-object picking, not precision tool-mediated torque.
comparison.success_condition: Hemostat, radio, and oximeter in tote; safe items remain upright; all still and grippers clear for 1 s.
comparison.reason: This is sorting under a safety rule, not mechanical calibration.
